account_brief_cases.description: At-risk account with clear churn language in tickets - should be flagged with verbatim quotes
Healthy account with no open risk tickets - should produce few/no risk flags
Churning account with budget-cut language - must be flagged as Budget/Renewal or Churn Signal
Account with repeated escalations requesting leadership call - should surface in talking points
New account with minimal history - brief should still be well-formed and not fabricate risk
Adversarial: account_id with no matching account record - must degrade gracefully, not crash or fabricate
Adversarial/determinism: same account run twice must yield identical risk flags and talking points
